compressed_character_metadata.limits: The inspected custom metadata reader validates chunk boundaries and PNG lengths but has no explicit decompressed-text cap. This is not a claim that the app or phone has unlimited memory.

facts: PNG import reads full input bytes, decompresses/decodes JSON, parses and normalizes it, and writes a new PNG.
The normal PNG card import path does not call avatar pixel decoding/cropping.
Saved output emits uncompressed tEXt chara and, for valid JSON, an additional uncompressed tEXt ccv3 payload.
Compressed import therefore reduces delivered input bytes but does not guarantee compressed on-device storage or small peak memory.
Thumbnail generation reads full source PNG and calls image::load_from_memory without stripping metadata.
The avatar processing helper also directly calls image::load_from_memory.
Stable Cargo.lock selects image 0.25.10 with png 0.18.1.
image 0.25.10 sets ignore_text_chunk(false), but png 0.18.1 ZTXtChunk::decode stores compressed bytes without decompressing.
The png text_metadata 2 MiB limit applies to explicit decompress_text; image calls that for matching IPTC/XMP metadata, not chara/ccv3.
Source inspection therefore does not indicate a chara-specific 2 MiB decompression failure in pixel decoding. Actual fixture tests are owned by the independent review agent.
Mobile default chunk size is 1 MiB; desktop is 4 MiB. These are per-chunk sizes, not total file size caps.
Acknowledgment follows file.flush(), and final staging size is checked.

release_history.fact: Release notes describe backend PNG read/write changes to prevent length errors on very large PNG files.
Release notes describe reduced import memory and decoupling Agent embedded asset scanning from character import.
Release notes describe fixing occasional character card import failures.

related_issue.scope: Linux desktop v2.2.0, roughly 1 MiB valid PNG cards, intermittent upload staging truncation. Not evidence of this user's phone root cause.
related_issue.fix: Flush staged chunks before acknowledgment. This implementation is present in inspected stable v2.3.0.

validation_boundary: This report is upstream source inspection, not mobile TauriTavern acceptance.
No user app/source/service/card data was changed by this research.
A separate Tauri-specific zTXt PNG can preserve raw JSON while reducing input bytes; keep the standard PNG for consumers whose metadata readers only support tEXt.
Full mobile import can still encounter memory, storage, bridge, or UI limits; device logs would be needed to establish a remaining root cause.
